title: Wrecks carrying liquor, including wine from the 1600s

tellings.quote: We found also one of the oldest wine in the world from 1600. Wow.

plain: Old shipwrecks on the floor of the Baltic Sea were carrying liquor, including what is said to be one of the oldest wines in the world, from the 1600s. A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says he found it himself around 2005, working with a man named Peter Lindberg, as part of his story of what lies on that seafloor.
